blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Maillardville. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Maillardville, Coquitlam: 15 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 1 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Maillardville fell from 16 in June to 15 in October (−6.2%), and 4 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 4.0% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Maillardville?
Maillardville also had 34 condos and townhomes listed and 5 sold in October, against 15 houses listed. The Maillardville condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Maillardville home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

7 houses sold in Maillardville with a median price of $1,890,000, taking a median of 61 days to sell at 94.4% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $447 per square foot, a median year built of 1991 and a median lot of 6,709 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Maillardville?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 15 houses listed in Maillardville. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Maillardville a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Maillardville had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Maillardville from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses sold in Maillardville over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Maillardville?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Maillardville sell for?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Maillardville between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,890,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Maillardville?
faq.a: The median was 61 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.4% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
